---
title: "Data Cleaning"
format: html
---

# Read in the ESS data


```{r}
#| label: dc-read-in
url <- glue::glue(
  "https://api.ess.sikt.no/v1/data/dataFile/10.21338/ess11e04_2?userId={Sys.getenv('ESS_USERID')}"
)

ess_in <- arrow::read_parquet(url)
```

# Create derived variables

```{r}
#| label: create-vars

library(dplyr)
library(forcats)
country_coding <-
  tibble::tribble(
    ~Code , ~Name                ,
    'AL'  , 'Albania'            ,
    'AT'  , 'Austria'            ,
    'BE'  , 'Belgium'            ,
    'BG'  , 'Bulgaria'           ,
    'CH'  , 'Switzerland'        ,
    'CY'  , 'Cyprus'             ,
    'CZ'  , 'Czechia'            ,
    'DE'  , 'Germany'            ,
    'DK'  , 'Denmark'            ,
    'EE'  , 'Estonia'            ,
    'ES'  , 'Spain'              ,
    'FI'  , 'Finland'            ,
    'FR'  , 'France'             ,
    'GB'  , 'United Kingdom'     ,
    'GE'  , 'Georgia'            ,
    'GR'  , 'Greece'             ,
    'HR'  , 'Croatia'            ,
    'HU'  , 'Hungary'            ,
    'IE'  , 'Ireland'            ,
    'IS'  , 'Iceland'            ,
    'IL'  , 'Israel'             ,
    'IT'  , 'Italy'              ,
    'LT'  , 'Lithuania'          ,
    'LU'  , 'Luxembourg'         ,
    'LV'  , 'Latvia'             ,
    'ME'  , 'Montenegro'         ,
    'MK'  , 'North Macedonia'    ,
    'NL'  , 'Netherlands'        ,
    'NO'  , 'Norway'             ,
    'PL'  , 'Poland'             ,
    'PT'  , 'Portugal'           ,
    'RO'  , 'Romania'            ,
    'RS'  , 'Serbia'             ,
    'RU'  , 'Russian Federation' ,
    'SE'  , 'Sweden'             ,
    'SI'  , 'Slovenia'           ,
    'SK'  , 'Slovakia'           ,
    'TR'  , 'Turkey'             ,
    'UA'  , 'Ukraine'            ,
    'XK'  , 'Kosovo'
  )

ess_der_all <-
  ess_in |>
  select(
    psu,
    cntry,
    stratum,
    anweight,
    happy,
    wrhpp,
    nwspol,
    volunfp,
    netusoft,
    netustm,
    agegroup,
    pdwrk:dngna
  ) |>
  mutate(
    # across(c(stratum, psu), ~as.character(.x) |> as.factor()),
    across(
      pdwrk:dngoth,
      ~ if_else(dngdk == 1 | dngref == 1 | dngna == 1, NA, .x),
      .names = "{.col}_rec"
    ),
    Retired = rtrd_rec == 1,
    wt1 = 1,
    Happy_Freq = if_else(wrhpp %in% 7:9, NA, wrhpp),
    Happy = if_else(happy %in% c(77, 88, 99), NA, happy),
    News = if_else(nwspol %in% c(7777, 8888, 9999), NA, nwspol),
    Country = recode_values(
      cntry,
      from = country_coding$Code,
      to = country_coding$Name
    ),
    Volunteer_12 = if_else(volunfp %in% 7:9, NA, volunfp),
    Volunteer_01 = case_when(
      volunfp == 1 ~ 1,
      volunfp == 2 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA
    ),
    Volunteer_Factor = case_when(
      volunfp == 1 ~ "Yes",
      volunfp == 2 ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ NA
    ) |>
      factor(levels = c("Yes", "No")),
    NetUsage = case_when(
      netusoft %in% 1:3 ~ 0,
      netustm %in% c(6666, 7777, 8888, 9999) ~ NA,
      TRUE ~ netustm
    ),
    NetFreq = recode_values(
      netusoft,
      1 ~ "Never",
      2 ~ "Only occasionally",
      3 ~ "A few times a week",
      4 ~ "Most days",
      5 ~ "Every day"
    ) |>
      fct_reorder(netusoft),
    AgeGroup = recode_values(
      agegroup,
      1 ~ '15-24',
      2 ~ '25-34',
      3 ~ '35-44',
      4 ~ '45-54',
      5 ~ '55-64',
      6 ~ '65-74',
      7 ~ '75+'
    ) |>
      fct_reorder(agegroup)
  )
```

# Check derived variables


```{r}
#| label: check-der-vars

ess_der_all |>
  count(Retired, rtrd_rec, rtrd, dngdk, dngref, dngna)

ess_der_all |>
  count(Happy_Freq, wrhpp)

ess_der_all |>
  count(Happy, happy)

ess_der_all |>
  filter(is.na(News)) |>
  count(nwspol)

ess_der_all |>
  filter(!is.na(News)) |>
  select(nwspol) |>
  summary()

ess_der_all |>
  count(Country, cntry) |>
  print(n = Inf)

ess_der_all |>
  count(pick(starts_with("vol")))

# NetUsage = case_when(
#   netusoft %in% 1:3 ~ 0,
#   netustm %in% c(6666, 7777, 8888, 9999) ~ NA,
#   TRUE ~ netustm
# ),

ess_der_all |>
  filter(NetUsage == 0 | is.na(NetUsage)) |>
  count(NetUsage, netusoft, netustm)

ess_der_all |>
  filter(NetUsage != 0) |>
  select(NetUsage, netustm, netusoft) |>
  summary()

ess_der_all |>
  count(NetFreq, netusoft)

ess_der_all |>
  count(AgeGroup, agegroup)
```

# Save data


```{r}
#| label: save-dat

ess_der <- ess_der_all |>
  select(any_of(names(ess_in)), everything())

summary(ess_der)

glimpse(ess_der)

readr::write_rds(
  ess_der,
  here::here("DerivedData", "ess11_der.rds"),
  compress = "gz"
)
```
